authority: Project Owner supplied direct/native Thangseng evidence
non_negotiable_rules: Direct Thangseng/native evidence takes precedence over stale repository values.
Do not invent a linguistic distinction merely to force one canonical form.
Do not delete a form when native evidence establishes it as a legitimate variant unless the evidence specifically says it is wrong.
Wrong live rows must be removed from runtime/build-source layers; historical evidence may remain in non-runtime audit documentation.
Linguistic agents must not make unsupported engineering changes; engineering agents must not adjudicate linguistic disputes.
All affected source layers and compiled/build layers must be checked so stale values cannot resurrect at runtime.

native_confirmed.can_rule_evidence: Thangseng: It is better to leave ama and man·a to be used freely; no strict rule regarding use/non-use of one or the other is recalled.

forest.instruction: Resolve the current forest collision using direct Thangseng/native evidence. Do not guess from frequency or existing repository majority.

gender_and_age.instruction: Trace Me·a versus Me·asa rather than mechanically collapsing them. Promote Thangseng-verified forms and delete old ko·ka/ko·ki from all live source/build layers if no distinct native sense supports them.

can_and_able.instruction: Resolve the dictionary representation without inventing a hard distinction. Determine whether able should share the same variant set and how canonical selection/variants should be represented.

sit_and_sitting.instruction: Treat these as native-confirmed values and audit every affected source/build/runtime layer.

ska_skenga.ska: desire / wish / want; native evidence includes want-to-eat usage
ska_skenga.skenga: documented as continuous/progressive form of ska in the current evidence set
ska_skenga.instruction: This is an active linguistic conflict. Evaluate all supplied usage cases and direct Thangseng evidence. Decide the natural usage of ska versus skenga, including whether ska is the basic want/desire form and skenga is a continuous/progressive realization, and whether both can occur in contexts translated as want. Do not decide from English glosses alone.

chiko_chibimao.instruction: Audit all Thangseng/native usage evidence and determine whether these are variants, different senses, or one is wrong. Do not guess.

other_requested_lexical_conflicts.instruction: Audit each word across dictionary, phrase maps, corrections, reconciliation, compiled data, and runtime outputs. Find all competing candidate forms and trace them to native/Thangseng evidence. Resolve only with evidence.

engineering_scope_for_claude_b.instruction: Resolve confirmed engineering/runtime/data-pipeline bugs after or alongside A's linguistic work, without deciding linguistic disputes.
required_checks: runtime smoke tests and regression tests
engineering_scope_for_claude_b.specific_requirement: If A changes ama/man·a, ska/skenga, sit/sitting, forest, gender terms, chiko/chibimao, finish/find/get/earn, verify that engineering logic preserves the linguistically approved result and does not resurrect stale values.
engineering_scope_for_claude_b.report_format: input → old output → root cause → fix → new output → tests

claude_c_role.instruction: Audit the evidence and resulting A/B changes independently. C must not silently rewrite linguistic decisions. Report unsupported conclusions, regressions, stale-layer resurrection, and mismatches between native evidence and shipped outputs.
claude_c_role.deliverable: Evidence matrix + pass/fail findings + exact files/keys affected + recommendation for A or B

order: C pre-audit evidence and current live outputs
verify HEAD == origin/main and zero divergence
do_not_merge_if: a linguistic decision is based only on frequency or English intuition
old ko·ka/ko·ki remains live after being rejected
stale source values can resurrect rejected values
compiled output disagrees with approved source data
tests pass but an approved native sentence regresses
